name: school-grading-system
description: School Grading System — monorepo root. Orchestrates the React client (client/) and the Express + Prisma API (server/) so the whole repository can be installed, built and started from the root (e.g. on Render with the default build command).

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-routes.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test
